title.narrative: Promotion of Sustainable Energy Practices in the Garment Sector in Cambodia

description.narrative: Promotion of Sustainable Energy Practices in the Garment Sector in Cambodia

While we are still waiting for the 2018 SWITCH call for proposals to be issued, we have started brainstorming with GERES, goverment counterparts, H&M and other industry players on an update of the 2017 proposal that would address: 1) Policy measures to promote energy efficiency in the garment sector. This could include energy performance standards energy management protocols data acquisition (smart metering, audits, MRV) 2) design of a financial instrument 3) awareness and demand stimulation
